pages.title: Rift Frame Casing
pages.text: A casing reinforced against tearing open: void lattice, graviton crystal and chronosteel over a hyperframe. It is built to sit at the edge of a rift between universes, and it feels faintly cold on one side.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Stabilising a multiverse rift tore through every casing I tried. I layered a void lattice shard, which is rigid even with nothing in it, over a hyperframe with graviton crystal to hold the geometry. It held.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Compactification.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Cosmogenic Casing, Multiverse Rift Stabilizer.
